pairs.registryProposal: encoding-corruption-ratchet names only the single-byte-codepage signature and U+FFFD; this repo hit a third byte-level class the structural gates are blind to - an escaping cascade that turned the ellipsis into literal backslash-u2026 runs across 176 values in 12 locales and also fooled value-parity into passing untranslated strings (scripts/i18n/check-escapes.mjs:5-19, gated at lefthook.yml:98). Worth naming as a sibling signature, with the lesson that corruption can mask untranslated values as translated.
